execution.memory_note: Optional traced peak excludes serialization, native allocations and interpreter baseline; no RSS bound is claimed.

limits.note: Logical input caps and one-case buffering; not a measured process RSS bound.

scope: Post-hoc descriptive saved-logit analysis; no model forward, independent execution attestation or population inference.

subset.scope: Exact selected mask-logit bytes and source event positions; source linkage is reported.

verification.scope: Saved schedule, mask logits, recorded doses and score; not a full activation replay.
